title: Fix Aged Accounts Receivable (Report 120) performance on large ledger history
summary: The Aged Accounts Receivable report (Report 120) now reads only the four columns it needs from Detailed Cust. Ledg. Entry inside its per-row loop. This lowers the per-row SQL cost on databases with long ledger history.
key_points: SetLoadFields added to the Detailed Cust. Ledg. Entry loop for Entry Type, Posting Date, Amount and Amount (LCY)
Reduces per-row SQL cost in a loop that scales with detailed ledger history
Same change applied to the W1, ES and NA base layers
